description: Confirmation receipt sent to the submitter when a new complaint is logged in the University Complaints Portal.
subject: Complaint received — tracking ID $tracking_id
body:
Dear $student_name,

This is to confirm that your complaint has been received by the University Complaints Portal. Our team will review it and respond as soon as possible.

Complaint Details:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Tracking ID:    $tracking_id
Subject:        $subject
Category:       $category
Priority:       $priority
Submitted:      $submitted_at
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What happens next:
• Your complaint has been queued for review.
• You can track its status at any time using the tracking ID above in the "Track Complaint" tab of the Complaints Portal.
• You will receive a follow-up message when an admin updates the status or posts a response.

If you did not submit this complaint, please contact the administration immediately so they can investigate.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention.

Kind regards,
University Complaints Office

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This is an automated notification. Please do not reply to this email.
